C01.data: finite m=1..N, unit x_m, positive w_m, omega real 3-vector

controls: all x_m parallel gives one-dimensional kernel
definitions: A is the 3N by 3 stack with block sqrt(w_m) times the map omega -> x_m cross omega
targets: v^T G v=sum_m w_m |v cross x_m|^2
two nonparallel directions imply G positive definite

exact_operator_bound: A has full column rank and sigma_min(A)>=sigma_*>0
exclusions: No calibrated derivative observation is constructed
No bound without Omega_* in the perturbed operator case
perturbed_operator_bound: Ahat has full column rank and sigma_min(Ahat)>=sigmahat_*>0
C03.tensor_identity: For delta W_ij=epsilon_ijk delta omega_k, ||delta W||F=sqrt(2)|delta omega|.

dependency.accepted_statement: CAS01 derivative-first convention leaves an arbitrary spatial skew W with W_ij=epsilon_ijk omega_k

frame_conventions.space: R^3 with Euclidean dot, cross, and norm
frame_conventions.units: omega, W, and y have rate units; x and weights are dimensionless after declared weighting; every norm is positive Euclidean/operator/Frobenius
frame_conventions.vorticity: W_ij=epsilon_ijk omega_k, hence W x=-omega cross x

source_policy: Exact definitions resolve symbols already present in the contracted C01-C03 statements. No historical axis script, derivation, or result is admitted.
